The current MOVES3 default average speeds are developed from the Coordinating Research Council’s (CRC’s) A-100 project (DenBleyker et al. 2017), which generated the heavy-duty vehicle speeds from telematics data. The CRC A-100 data utilized county-specific average speeds collected across the United States. For use in default MOVES, the EPA aggregated the county-level speeds to obtain national average speeds by source type, road type, day type, and hour of the day. For heavy-duty trucks, speeds were developed from two broad groups: heavy- 1 The vehicle speed for most of the 2-minute segments was 28 mph for these vehicles removed from the analysis. The speeds from the heavy-duty commercial trucks were applied to the combination truck source types in MOVES (combination short-haul and long-haul), and the medium-duty commercial speeds were applied to the single-unit source types in MOVES, including buses, refuse trucks, motorhomes, single-unit short-haul, and single-unit long-haul. There are slight differences in the average speeds among the MOVES3 default speeds within source types mapped from the same CRC source (e.g., transit buses and school buses) because the distribution of activity for each source type varies across counties. More description of the derivation of the default average speeds in MOVES3 is included in the MOVES3 population and activity report (EPA 2021). From the CRC A-100 data set, large amounts of data for all day types, hours of the day, and MOVES road types proved advantageous; however, the CRC A-100 data set cannot be used to estimate vocation-specific average speeds, such as for transit buses and refuse trucks. The objective of this work is to develop source-type-specific average speed distributions from the FleetDNA data set for potential use in MOVES as national default values, and to make these available to users to represent local vehicle fleets. We also intend for this work to guide future data collection efforts of heavy-duty activity and provide recommended methods for analyzing and aggregating instrumented vehicle data across different vehicles and fleets.
